meta.name: Yakshini
meta.description:
A spirit named Maya, cursed to live among mortals as punishment for a wicked deed, embarks on a mission to sacrifice 100 men to save her kind, but her resolve wavers when she encounters a kind-hearted young man named Krishna.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: The Hope
videos.overview: Anxious to find her 100th victim to break free from a curse, Maya spots a dejected-in-love Krishna and proposes to him. After ages, finally, Mahakal gets a clue about Maya.

videos.title: The Hunt
videos.overview: The Saugandhika flower, with the power to tame a Yakshini, leads Mahakal to Jwalamukhi and not Maya. When Krishna refuses to get intimate, a desperate Maya agrees to marry him.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Young Mahakal had promised his Guru to rule over Alkapuri. Years later, the Saugandhika flower finally leads him to his destination.

videos.title: The Revelation
videos.overview: Aeons ago, Mahakal had entrapped Maya. Years later, Maya's plan gets averted by Ramarao's death. Finally, she learns who is delaying her escape to Alkapuri.

videos.title: The Vengeance
videos.overview: Years ago, Mahakal had ensnared a smitten Maya in his temple. Krishna learns that Maya is a Yakshini. Enraged, Jwalamukhi decides to get Mahakal from Mayaranyam to trap Maya.

videos.title: The Beginning
videos.overview: Maya learnt from Kubera about her curse years ago. In the present, Mahakal traps Maya in the Guptamandiram. Realising his mistake, Krishna rushes to help Maya.
